text:
Anya: FYI I opened a small docs PR to clarify when KV prefetch improves latency vs when it adds overhead for very short sequences. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/357
Marco: Can you paste the exact change? quick scan only.
Anya: Change snippet and sentence: `client.generate({ model: 'gpt-small', max_tokens: 32, batch_size: 2, prefetch_kv: true })` and new line: 'KV prefetch reduces token work when identical prefixes are common across requests; for tiny single-shot requests the setup cost can exceed benefits.'
Priya: Suggest adding a one-line note about quant profiles: 4-bit (q4) often increases compute variance; recommend `quant_profile: balanced` for short seqs.
Rohan: I ran quick micro-benchmarks on an NV4 devbox: seq=32 batch=1 median=12ms; batch=4 median=9ms; enabling prefetch_kv: batch=1 -> +2ms, batch=4 -> -3ms when prefixes align. Posting raw numbers so docs can show ballpark.
docs-bot: Link check OK: PR reachable, no broken links.
Marco: LGTM. Minor: change 'always' -> 'commonly' and wrap `prefetch_kv` and `quant_profile` in code ticks. Add Node SDK example if possible.
Anya: Added Node example inline: `await client.responses.create({ model: 'gpt-small', input: prompt, max_tokens: 32, batching: { batch_size: 2 }, prefetch_kv: true })` Marking Go example as TODO.
Priya: Also add a tiny decision box: when to choose prefetch vs rely on batching-only. Keep it 1-2 bullets.
Anya: Done  I added a 3-row micro-bench table (batch=1/2/4) and a 2-bullet decision box. Planning to merge in ~20m unless objections.
Marco: No objections, added `docs:nit` label.
Rohan: One nit: call out that quant_profile recommendations depend on model family; maybe append 'for small dense models' to avoid overgeneralizing.
Anya: Good point, updated text.
Priya: :thumbsup:
Anya: Merged and pushed. I'll add a short blurb for release notes and ping #docs-subscribers. Thanks everyone!
